description: The transcripts of Basic LAnguage Resource Kit 1.0 for Faroese. No recipe reads them. Its transcripts are BLARK's TextGrid files, inside archives that total about 28 GB, and a fetch holds a whole download in memory, so no fetch can read them (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212).
